records.name: 淘盘
records.versionEvidence: 1.0: Introduced. 1.4: Can now be trashed. Can be bought at Willy's Fish Shop after receiving the first one. Can now be used as a hat. 1.5: Can find Fossilized Tail and Taro Tubers on Ginger Island. Can now find the Lucky Ring by panning. 1.6: Can now be upgraded to steel, gold, and iridium version at the Blacksmith. Pans can be enchanted. Can now find Bone Fragments, Mystery Boxes, Artifacts, clothing and furniture. Shimmering lights no longer appear every half hour at the Ginger Island Dig Site. Pan no longer yields the same thing if the player pans in the same spot twice in the same day.
records.acquisition: 完成鱼缸收集包或购买Joja淘金项目移除闪光巨石后，从威利处获得；解锁后鱼店补购价格2500g。
records.purpose: 每次淘金可得3至9个矿石，最多1项特殊物品。
records.limitation: 只能在水边闪光的淘金点使用；上限不是每次必得数量。淘盘可佩戴，但工具等级与帽子外观不是两次升级。
